title: Nourishing Fluffy Argentinian Chicken Empanadas
description: Tangy and fluffy empanadas filled with chicken, ginger garlic paste, and spices, perfect for a sick day, and made with halal-friendly ingredients and a brine-dry method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Add the beaten egg and water to the bowl, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chicken breast, ginger garlic paste, onion, and black pepper.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle, and place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush with a little water.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
